limitations: No persisted per-world rollout action log: common-world reuse is not independently auditable.
The certificate flag is cross-checked against statuses and trace truth; continuous absence geometry is not re-proved.
Stored lower-bound values and ratios are checked for consistency; exponential path-bound calculation is not rerun.

statistical_method.sampling_unit: original_case_group; average reconstruction deltas within group, then bootstrap groups
statistical_method.failed_run_policy: Failed/audit-failed runs never improve mean completion time; full mean is null, pair exclusions explicit.
statistical_method.duplicate_policy: Conflicting duplicates remain in CSV and conflict list, and are excluded from summary selection.

journal_audit.scope: Persisted hypothetical branches; history compatibility, paired worlds, independent8 adoption and full costs
journal_audit.limits: Unselected candidate branches retain complete costs/status but not full future action histories; finite worlds are not a universal certificate.
